detail: One row per sample point (15 random plant triplets per field); the three fields are the explanatory factor, fitted fixed (glm(AphidCount ~ Field, family = poisson())), and fall under five levels.
Completely randomized design, one row per female; lm(log10(Eggs) ~ Species * MateType).
Completely randomized 2 x 3 x 2 factorial with four replicates, one row per sample; lm(C ~ Size * Weight * Time) with Weight and Time as factors.
Completely randomized design, one row per pot; lm(Length ~ Calcium).
calcium with the treatment coded as the dummy columns d1-d4; calcium itself has no grouping.
Completely randomized 3 x 4 factorial with two replicates, one row per unit; lm(log(Absorbance) ~ Prep * Conc).
Two experimental runs fitted as a fixed block (glm(Conidia ~ Run + (log(Time) + Period) * Source, family = poisson())), under five levels; one row per unit.
Completely randomized 5 x 5 factorial of herbicide and insecticide doses (Kuehl 2000), one row per treatment combination; lm(Weight ~ H * I).
Completely randomized design of the ten crosses of five female and two male parents, one row per seed, and no model on the page; the parents are the design's treatment factors.
Completely randomized design, one row per tray; glm(cbind(Normal, Total - Normal) ~ Dose, family = binomial()).
One row per suction-trap site of the EXAMINE project; step(lm(JDay ~ . - Trap)).
One row per forest plot, the three stand types fitted fixed; lm(log(SD) ~ log(QD) * Type).
forest with the stand type coded as the dummy columns d1-d3; forest itself has no grouping.

Completely randomized design of 24 pots on a bench grid of four rows and six columns; the help fits the bench columns as a fixed term (lm(Height ~ Column + Dose)), a spatial adjustment by grid coordinates (connolly.potato ruling) over six exhaustive positions.
The layout of two replicated 5 x 5 Latin squares only (Field, Row, Column, Treatment); no measured response.
The layout of two replicated 5 x 5 Latin squares only (Rep, Stack, Position, Treatment); no measured response.
A 4 x 4 Latin square, its rows and columns fitted fixed (lm(Height ~ Row + Column + Treatment)) and under five levels each; one row per pot.
The plot means of potatorow's four row yields per plot (e.g. block 1 plot 1: 642, the mean of 720, 528, 678 and 642).
Completely randomized design, one row per plot; lm(TGW ~ Damage * Trt).
One transect with four plants at each of six distances; lm(log10(Count) ~ Distance + fDist), fDist the distance as a factor for lack of fit.
Two occasions fitted as a fixed block (lm(log(Km) ~ Rep + Voltage)), under five levels; one row per voltage and occasion.
Four study sites fitted fixed with their own slopes (lm(log10(TotalSeed) ~ Site * (HLength + Spikelets))), under five levels; one row per sample point.
Completely randomized comparison of two varieties, one row per plot; lm(Yield ~ Variety).
One row per launch or test firing; the page plots Total on Temperature.
Monthly mean total ozone at one station (Halley Bay) per year, the months as columns.
One row per trapping site of possum: longitude, latitude and altitude.
Deaths in London by cause per year, 1629-1881 with gaps: one multiple time series.
One row per man of the PSID comparison group (Dehejia and Wahba 1999); re78 is the outcome, re74 and re75 the pre-program earnings.
The subset of psid1 matched to the experimental data, as the page says.
The subset of psid1 matched to the experimental data, as the page says.
One row per Scottish hill race; type classifies the races.
One row per tree; the four species classify and fall under five levels, and the page only tabulates them.

One row per replicated study of the Open Science Collaboration (2015); the book regresses the replication effect size on the original's (Maindonald, Braun and Andrews 2024, exercise 3.17, MASS::rlm(T_r.R ~ T_r.O)).
One row per plant; the block is fitted fixed with one degree of freedom (aov(ShootDryMass ~ Block + variety * fert), Maindonald and Braun 2010, section 7.2.1; 2024, section 4.2.1), under five levels.
Presence of 614 motif features at 103 Pacific rock-art sites, analyzed by multidimensional scaling; no response.
One row per roller weight; lm(depression ~ weight).
One row per survey respondent; BDI regressed on principal components of the support scores.
One row per e-mail; rpart(yesno ~ crl.tot + dollar + bang + money + n000 + make).
Completely randomized design, one row per sample; aov(weight ~ trt).
Completely randomized design, one row per plant; aov(log(weight) ~ trt).
Three cars, fitted as a fixed factor (lm(distance ~ angle + factor(car))) and under five levels; one row per run.
The averages by site and parcel of stVincent's plots of treatment 111 (e.g. CPSV parcel I: 26.3, the mean of 26.5 and 26.1); its id and plot columns are averages too.
One row per play over two nights; the page tabulates the window symbols.
One row per age, the male and female counts and average wages as columns.
Whooping-cough deaths in London per year, 1740-1881: one multiple time series.
One row per record distance on road or track; the page plots log(Time) on log(Distance).
One row per forest stand: the population means of the auxiliary variables that the EBLUP of ulal.sub.samp.dat predicts with.
